content.json: SAP Audit Controls (Preview) --- The workbook provides the following capabilities for your compliance program: * See recommendations on which analytics rules to enable, and enable them in-place with proper pre-set configuration. * Associate your analytics rules to the SOX or NIST control framework, or apply your own custom control framework. * Review incidents and alerts summarized by control, according to the selected control framework. * Export relevant incidents for further analysis, for auditing and reporting purposes.

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.query:
where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| extend value= strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId)
| extend selected= iff(subscriptionId contains '{default:subscription}', 1, 0)
| summarize selected= max(selected) by value, subscriptionId

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.query:
where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| project id, name
| extend selected = iff(name == '{default:label}', 1, 0)

parameters.name: InternalRG
parameters.query:
where type =~ "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"
| where id =~  "{Workspace}"
| project resourceGroup

parameters.name: Status
parameters.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize Count = count(IncidentNumber) by Status
| project Value = Status, Label = strcat(Status, ": ", Count)

parameters.name: Severity
parameters.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize Count = count(IncidentNumber) by Severity
| project Value = Severity, Label = strcat(Severity, ": ", Count)

parameters.name: Tactics
parameters.query:
SecurityIncident
| extend Tactics = todynamic(AdditionalData.tactics)
| mvexpand Tactics to typeof(string)
| summarize Count=count(IncidentNumber) by Tactics
| project Value = Tactics, Label = strcat(Tactics, ": ", Count)

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.query:
SecurityIncident
| extend owner = tostring(Owner.assignedTo) 
| summarize Count=count(IncidentNumber) by Owner= case(owner=="", "Unassigned",owner)
| project Value = Owner, Label = strcat(Owner, ": ", Count)

parameters.name: SystemRoles
parameters.label: System roles
parameters.query:
let EmptySystems= datatable ( SystemID: string, SystemID_s:string , SystemUsage: string, SystemRole: string, Count: long  )['All Systems', 'All Systems', 'All System Usage', 'All System Roles', 1];
let AuditSystems = union isfuzzy= true (SAPAuditLog | distinct SystemID_s= SystemID), (EmptySystems| project SystemID, SystemID_s) | summarize by SystemID= SystemID_s;
AuditSystems
| lookup kind=inner (SAPSystems() | union isfuzzy=true EmptySystems) on SystemID
| extend ranked= iff(SystemRole != "Unknown (Production)",array_sum(to_utf8(SystemRole)), 20.0)
| summarize Ranked= any(ranked) by SystemRole
| order by Ranked desc
| serialize Rank = row_number()
| project value= SystemRole, label= strcat('💎', SystemRole), selected= iff(Rank==1, true, false)

parameters.name: SystemUsage
parameters.label: System usage
parameters.query:
let EmptySystems= datatable ( SystemID: string, SystemID_s:string , SystemUsage: string, SystemRole: string, Count: long  )['All Systems', 'All Systems', 'All Usage Types', 'All System Roles', 1];
let AuditSystems = union isfuzzy= true (SAPAuditLog | distinct SystemID_s= SystemID), (EmptySystems| project SystemID, SystemID_s, SystemUsage) | summarize by SystemID= SystemID_s, SystemUsage;
AuditSystems
| lookup (SAPSystems(SelectedSystemRoles=dynamic("{SystemRoles}"))) on SystemID
| extend SystemUsage= strcat(SystemUsage, SystemUsage1)
| extend ranked= array_sum(to_utf8(SystemUsage))
| summarize Ranked= any(ranked) by SystemUsage
| where isnotempty(SystemUsage)
| order by Ranked desc
| serialize Rank = row_number()
//| where isnotempty(SystemUsage) or SystemID == 'All Systems'
| project value= SystemUsage, label= strcat('🌐', SystemUsage), selected= iff(Rank==1, true, false)

parameters.name: Systems
parameters.query:
let EmptySystems= datatable ( SystemID: string, SystemID_s:string , SystemUsage: string, SystemRole: string, Count: long  )['All Systems', 'All Systems', 'All System Usage', 'All System Roles', 1];
let AuditSystems = union isfuzzy= true (SAPAuditLog | distinct SystemID_s= SystemID), (EmptySystems| project SystemID, SystemID_s, SystemRole) | summarize SystemRole= any(SystemRole) by SystemID= SystemID_s
| extend ranked= array_sum(to_utf8(SystemID));
AuditSystems
| lookup (SAPSystems(SelectedSystemRoles=dynamic("{SystemRoles}"), SelectedSystemUsage=dynamic("{SystemUsage}")) ) on SystemID
//| extend SystemRole = strcat(SystemRole, SystemRole1)
| extend SystemRole = SystemRole1
| where isnotempty(SystemRole)
| summarize Ranked= any(ranked) by SystemID, SystemRole, SystemUsage
| order by Ranked desc
| serialize Rank = row_number()
| extend SystemID= iff("{DemoMode}" == "true", toupper(substring(hash_sha256(SystemID), 0, 3)), SystemID)
| project value= SystemID, label= strcat('🛡️', SystemID)

parameters.name: ControlFrameWork
parameters.label: Control framework
parameters.query:
let ARMD= materialize(SAPWSAlertRuleMetaData);
let ControlTypes= ARMD
| getschema 
| where ColumnName contains "ControlFamily"
| project value= replace_string(ColumnName,"ControlFamily",""), ColumnName;
let Labels= ARMD | evaluate basket();
Labels | evaluate narrow()
| where Column in ((ControlTypes | summarize by ColumnName))
| where isnotempty( Value)
| extend Column= replace_string(Column,"ControlFamily","")
| distinct Column
//| summarize label= make_set(Value) by Column
//| extend label= strcat("🛂 "," ", Column, " ", translate('"',' ', tostring(label)))
| extend label= Column
| project value= Column, label
| extend IsSelected= iff(value contains "SOX", 1, 0)
| order by IsSelected

parameters.name: ControlFamilys
parameters.label: Control families
parameters.query:
let NA = datatable(value: string)["Not assigned"];
SAPWSAlertRuleMetaData
| summarize by value= {ControlFrameWork}ControlFamily
| union NA
| extend label = strcat("🎛️", value)
| where value != "Not assigned"

parameters.name: ControlIDs
parameters.label: Control IDs
parameters.query:
let NA = datatable(value: string, ControlID: string)["Not assigned", "Not assigned"];
SAPWSAlertRuleMetaData
| extend ControlFamily= {ControlFrameWork}ControlFamily
| where ControlFamily in ({ControlFamilys}) or "*" in ({ControlFamilys})
| summarize Count= dcount(RuleID) by value= {ControlFrameWork}ControlID
| union NA
| project value, label = strcat("🎛️", value, " (",Count, iff(Count > 1," rules)"," rule)"))
| where value != "Not assigned"

parameters.name: DemoMode
parameters.query: {"version":"1.0.0","content":"[{\"value\": true, \"label\":\"true\"},{\"value\":false,\"label\":\"false\", \"selected\": true}]"}

parameters.name: IncidentsRetentionDays
parameters.query:
print IncidentsRetentionDays= (toscalar(SecurityIncident | summarize MinTG= min(TimeGenerated)
| project IncidentsRetentionDays= 1 + datetime_diff('day', now(), MinTG)))

parameters.name: IncidentsRetentionDaysJudgement
parameters.query:
let IncidentsRetentionDays= {IncidentsRetentionDays};
print(toscalar(iff(IncidentsRetentionDays >= 730, "Good", "Bad")))

content.json:
#### Oldest incident found in this workspace is {IncidentsRetentionDays} days old.
This dashboard allows for an aggregated view of incidents and alerts based on the *SecurityAlert* and *SecurityIncident* tables, which currently retain {IncidentsRetentionDays} days of data. Consider extending the retention period for these tables to match your organization's compliance requirements. Regardless of the choice you make for the retention policy of these tables, the incident data itself is never deleted, though it might not show up here. Alert data is kept according to the alert table's retention policy.

See [Configure a data retention policy for a table in a Log Analytics workspace](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/configure-data-retention) for more information.

content.query:
let SelectedSystems= materialize(SAPSystems(SelectedSystemRoles=dynamic("{SystemRoles}")
, SelectedSystems=todynamic("[{Systems}]")
, SelectedSystemUsage= dynamic("{SystemUsage}")) | project SystemID, SystemRole);
let ARMetaData= materialize(SAPWSAlertRuleMetaData());
let Templates= ARMetaData | summarize makeset(AnalyticsTemplateId);
//let DefaultItemID= toscalar(ARMetaData | where RuleID == "DefaultRule" | project ItemId);
let TimeBucket= max_of(1, floor({TimeRange:seconds}/3600/20, 1));
let StepSize= totimespan(strcat(TimeBucket, "h"));
SAPWSIncidentsDetailed
| where ((CreatedTime >= {TimeRange:start} and CreatedTime <= {TimeRange:end}) or (AlertStartTime >= {TimeRange:start} and AlertStartTime <= {TimeRange:end}))
| extend CreatedTime= coalesce(CreatedTime, AlertStartTime)
| project IncidentNumber, TimeGenerated, Severity, Status, Product, SAPSystem, Tactics, Owner, CreatedTime, AlertRuleUniqueName, SystemAlertId, AnalyticRuleName, tostring(AnalyticsTemplateId), AnalyticRuleId
| where SAPSystem in((SelectedSystems | summarize by SystemID)) or isempty(SAPSystem)
| where Severity in ({Severity}) or "*" in ({Severity}) or isempty(IncidentNumber)
| where Status in ({Status}) or "*" in ({Status}) or isempty(IncidentNumber)
| where Owner in ({Owner}) or "*" in ({Owner}) or isempty(IncidentNumber)
| where arraylength(set_intersect(Tactics, dynamic([{Tactics}]))) > 0 or "*" in ({Tactics}) 
| extend AnalyticsTemplateId= coalesce(tostring(AnalyticsTemplateId), AnalyticRuleId) // to handle non-templates, use alert ID
| join kind= fullouter (ARMetaData | extend AnalyticsTemplateId=tostring(AnalyticsTemplateId)) on AnalyticsTemplateId
| extend ControlID= {ControlFrameWork}ControlID
| extend ControlID= iff(isnotempty(ControlID), ControlID, "Not assigned")
| where ControlID in ({ControlIDs}) or "*" in ({ControlIDs})
| extend ControlFamily= {ControlFrameWork}ControlFamily
| extend ControlFamily= iff(isnotempty(ControlFamily), ControlFamily, "Not assigned")
| where ControlFamily in ({ControlFamilys}) or "*" in ({ControlFamilys})
| extend CreatedTime= coalesce(CreatedTime, ago(4h))
| extend AlertRuleUniqueName= coalesce(AlertRuleUniqueName, RuleID)
| extend AnalyticRuleName= coalesce(AnalyticRuleName, AnalyticRuleName1)
| extend ItemId= iff(isempty(RuleID), "{DefaultItemID}", coalesce(ItemId, AnalyticRuleId))
| extend AnalyticsTemplateId= coalesce(tostring(AnalyticsTemplateId), tostring(AnalyticsTemplateId1))
| make-series IncidentCount= dcountif(IncidentNumber, isnotempty(IncidentNumber)) default= 0, AlertCount=dcountif(SystemAlertId, isnotempty(SystemAlertId)) default= 0 on CreatedTime from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step StepSize by AnalyticRuleName, AlertRuleUniqueName, AnalyticsTemplateId, ItemId, IncidentPriority= RecommendedConfiguration, AnalyticRuleId
| extend TotalIncidentCount= array_sum(IncidentCount), TotalAlertCount=array_sum(AlertCount), HasTemplate=iff(AnalyticsTemplateId != ItemId, true, false)
| extend QueryHasSAP= iff(isnotempty(IncidentPriority),"SAP","")
| order by isnotempty(QueryHasSAP) desc, TotalIncidentCount desc, TotalAlertCount desc

parameters.name: RuleRecommendations
parameters.query:
let SelectedRule= "{SelectedRule:escapejson}";
print SelectedRule= SelectedRule
| parse-kv SelectedRule as(RuleName:string, RuleID: string, HasTemplate: string, ['Enable alerts']: bool, ['Enable incidents']: bool, IncidentPriority: string) with (pair_delimiter=',', kv_delimiter=':', quote='"')
| extend HasTemplate= tobool(replace_string(HasTemplate,"}",""))

let SelectedSystems= materialize(SAPSystems(SelectedSystemRoles=dynamic("{SystemRoles}")

let ARMetaData= SAPWSAlertRuleMetaData() | where RuleID != "DefaultRule";
SAPWSIncidentsDetailed
| where ((CreatedTime >= {TimeRange:start} and CreatedTime <= {TimeRange:end}) or (AlertStartTime >= {TimeRange:start} and AlertStartTime <= {TimeRange:end}))
| extend CreatedTime= coalesce(CreatedTime, AlertStartTime)
| project IncidentNumber, TimeGenerated, Severity, Status, Product, SAPSystem, Tactics, Owner, CreatedTime, AlertRuleUniqueName, SystemAlertId, AnalyticRuleName, AnalyticsTemplateId, AnalyticRuleId
| extend AnalyticRuleName= replace_string(AnalyticRuleName, "SAP - ","")
| where SAPSystem in((SelectedSystems | summarize by SystemID)) or isempty(SAPSystem)
| extend SAPSystem= iff("{DemoMode}" == "true", toupper(substring(hash_sha256(SAPSystem), 0, 3)), SAPSystem)
| where Severity in ({Severity}) or "*" in ({Severity}) 
| where Status in ({Status}) or "*" in ({Status})
| where Owner in ({Owner}) or "*" in ({Owner})
| where arraylength(set_intersect(Tactics, dynamic([{Tactics}]))) > 0 or "*" in ({Tactics})
| extend AnalyticsTemplateId= coalesce(tostring(AnalyticsTemplateId), AnalyticRuleId)
| join kind= fullouter (ARMetaData | extend AnalyticsTemplateId=tostring(AnalyticsTemplateId), IncidentPriority= RecommendedConfiguration) on AnalyticsTemplateId
| extend ControlID= {ControlFrameWork}ControlID
| extend ControlID= iff(isnotempty(ControlID), ControlID, "Not assigned")
| where ControlID in ({ControlIDs}) or "*" in ({ControlIDs})
| extend ControlFamily= {ControlFrameWork}ControlFamily
| extend ControlFamily= iff(isnotempty(ControlFamily), ControlFamily, "Not assigned")
| where ControlFamily in ({ControlFamilys}) or "*" in ({ControlFamilys})
| lookup SelectedSystems on $left.SAPSystem == $right.SystemID
| extend IncidentsTrendDetailLevel= column_ifexists("{IncidentsTrendDetailLevel}", "N/A")
| extend IncidentsTrendDetailLevel= iff(isempty(IncidentsTrendDetailLevel),"N/A", IncidentsTrendDetailLevel)
| extend QueryHasSAP= iff(isnotempty(IncidentPriority),"SAP","")
| where (CreatedTime >= {TimeRange:start} and CreatedTime <= {TimeRange:end})
| summarize IncidentCount= dcount(IncidentNumber) by bin(CreatedTime, 3h), IncidentsTrendDetailLevel
